page.running_head: De Agro Frif. inter Lavic. & Amaf.

main_text.p: data,tribusEdsardi arcibus occupatis,Ed-fardus imparem se solum tantæ moli sen-tiens ad Carolum Geldriæ Ducem Gallorum regis socium ; Burgundis & Austriacis inimicum, se contulit, ut auxilia ab eo pararet. Is fortunam sequens versuti princeps ingenii, promisit benignè, pecuniamque etiam in eum finem accepit. Sed miles promissus non ante venit, quàm Dammona quoque vi essèt à Saxonibus occupata, & Groninga in arctum redacta. Et tum Geldri legatus, qui auxiliis præerat ; Guilhelmus Oijensis, in extrema civitatis necessitate cùm differri diutiùs deditio non posse uideretur, profesus etiam est, sic sibi mandatum à principe, ne quid opis pressis ferret, neu rebus Edsardi civitatisque ullo se modo misceret, ni priùs hæc illius fide soluta in Geldricum nomen jurasset: nec enim æquum esse, principem tantam rem tam sumptuosam, difficilem, periculosam aggredi, tanti hostis offensionem in se suscipere, omnemque

page.notes: Left margin notes: "Edsardus à Carolo Geldro auxilia petit." (beside "tiens ad Carolum") and "Caroli artes." (beside "versuti princeps"). Both are printed in smaller italic type. Doubtful: "peffun-data" at the line break is read as "peffun-" with a hyphen that may be a period; the rest of the line break is uncertain. "Ed-fardus" is joined from the line break. "essèt" and "Frisiâ" are kept as printed. Printing error or doubtful spelling: "Edsardi" and "Edsardus" are printed without a space in "tribusEdsardi". The faint "Digitized by Google" line at the bottom right is omitted as a digitiser's mark.
